title: The Explorer's Journey
theme: A hero travels through ancient lands, meeting guides and speaking of prophecies.

dialogue.speaker: hero
dialogue.text: The morning mist rises over the ruins as I stand ready.
dialogue.subtitle: Standing ready in the morning mist.

dialogue.speaker: hero
dialogue.text: I walk forward across the ancient stone path toward the temple.
dialogue.subtitle: Walking across the ancient stone path.

dialogue.speaker: hero
dialogue.text: Behold the secrets inscribed in stone by the ancestors of old!
dialogue.subtitle: Speaking of ancestral secrets.
